text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond and I have come to watch the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I actually get to run with you, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Don't get too excited, Kita. You might end up stumbling out of the gate.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Some of the runners were invited from overseas. There are a lot of unknown variables today…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But no matter who I'm up against, the mighty Teio is gonna crush 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You won't find crushing me that easy! I'll be the one taking you down!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to see Kita's really fired up today!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Go, Kitasan! You've got what it takes to surpass your idol!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Overthrow the Monarch! We know you can do it, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Tokai Teio! Show them the grandeur of the Monarch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It looks like the support from the crowd is around a fifty-fifty split…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them have extremely passionate fans. This is shaping up to be one of the most exciting Japan Cups to date.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Do your best out there, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's Tokai Teio! She's rapidly gaining ground from the rear! She's right on Kitasan Black's tail!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What?! Already?! Teio normally hangs back for longer than this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio boldly takes the battle directly to Kitasan Black, sticking closely behind her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a strategy that we've not often seen from Tokai Teio before.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaghhh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Ahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita's responding to Teio's challenge… No, wait! What's this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling the pressure, Kitasan Black increases her speed for a time, but she gradually slows back down to her initial pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fierce back-and-forth battle unfolds between Tokai Teio and Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Both Kita and Teio have the advantage of having raced in the Japan Cup before…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They're not running their own races—they're taking the fight to each other!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …What would I do in that situation?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Satono Diamond fixedly watches the race, she starts to picture how she would approach it.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here comes Tokai Teio! Will Kitasan Black hold on for the win, or will Tokai Teio pass her?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That really threw me off! I never imagined you'd run so aggressively…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about? I wouldn't have had any chance at all if I stuck to a defensive strategy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll never lose that urge to take on a challenge. It's all so I can continue to reach greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm gonna bring the fight to you and Dia in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You better be ready for me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Her desire for a challenge… That's what being an illustrious racer means to Teio…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (McQueen valiantly accepts challenges from others, while Teio embodies the role of a fierce challenger.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (So what about me?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I won a G1 race for the Satono family… I overcame the jinx and seized victory.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I chased after Kita and raced against her in the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I've got it!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a long silence, Satono Diamond begins to speak with a determined look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'd like to continue taking on new challenges.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. I've challenged myself with various goals time and again to get this far. Breaking the jinx holding back the Satono family… Chasing after Kita…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's why I think being the kind of illustrious runner who takes on all kinds of challenges is the best path for me to take.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Challenging McQueen and Teio was my first step towards that path—the first new page of my contribution to the annals of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: By facing all kinds of challenges, I want to carve out a place for myself in the history of both the Satono family and the world of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Which brings me to say—my desire to compete overseas has been rekindled.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm not doing it to prove it's possible. It's simply what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to win an overseas race and etch the Satono family name into Umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: By doing so, I hope to break new ground for both my family and for all the Umamusume racing in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I think that is how I can contribute to the world of Umamusume.
choice_data_list: It looks like you've found your answer.
It looks like you've found your answer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is the kind of illustrious racer that I wish to be. I know what I need to strive for now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: First up—I'm going to win the Arima Kinen and join the ranks of the most illustrious racers!
